_comment: How blocks are taken away from a thing, and how much: the land weathered, what stands crumbled, round holes cut
through. Two parts, each word giving what it gives -- `ancient` a great amount, `porous` the way -- and those said of
one thing combining: `ancient porous landmass` is holed through at a great amount. Eroded where no word says the way,
and a mild amount where none intensifies. Each part's page says which of its settings each way turns.
